description.value: A cheerful breakfast-and-lunch diner on Beacon Avenue in Sidney by the Sea, The Five & Dime serves creative takes on diner classics — from BBQ pulled-pork pancakes to stuffed Belgian waffles — alongside a full boozy brunch cocktail list. Locally made bread underpins the lunch sandwich menu, and the kitchen accommodates gluten-free diners with a bread substitute. It bills itself as a 'little diner by the sea' with an easygoing, everyone-welcome atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides authoritative contact details (address: 2305 Beacon Ave / #3-2305 Beacon Avenue, Sidney, BC V8L 1W9; phone: +1 778-351-1555) absent from the OSM record. Online ordering ('ORDER ONLINE' in navigation) confirms takeout capability. The menu explicitly lists gluten-free bread as a substitute and includes vegetarian-friendly items (Grilled Veg sandwich, salads), but there is no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging on any page.
concerns: OSM record contains no address, phone, or email — all contact details were sourced solely from the website.
Website uses informal variant name 'The Five n Dime Diner' (with 'n') alongside the OSM name 'The Five & Dime Diner' (with '&'); likely the same business but worth confirming on-site signage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating diner on Sidney's main commercial street with a full menu well-suited to hungry touring cyclists; address and phone confirmed via website.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free bread available as a sandwich substitute; vegetarian options include Grilled Veg sandwich (avocado, roasted red peppers, tomato, pesto, brie) and multiple salads
